translations.A transcrição é salva automaticamente co: The transcript is saved automatically as a note when you stop.
translations.Ao iniciar, o navegador pedirá pra escol: When you start, the browser will ask you to pick a tab/window. Tick
translations.Arraste um arquivo de áudio ou vídeo aqu: Drag an audio or video file here, or
translations.Atenção: persistência local indisponível: Warning: local persistence unavailable. You will not be able to resume if the page closes.
translations.Áudios maiores que esse tamanho são envi: Audios larger than this size are sent via the Files API (resumable upload), avoiding the 20 MB inline_data limit. Recommended: 18.
translations.Áudios maiores que esse tempo serão divi: Audios longer than this will be split into parts to avoid truncation.
translations.Capturar áudio de uma aba ou tela: Capture audio from a tab or screen
translations.Chave de API do provedor selecionado. Op: API key for the selected provider. OpenAI and Gemini require it; local Ollama usually doesn't — but if your Ollama is behind an authenticated gateway/cloud, fill it in here.
translations.Deixe em branco para usar a chave Gemini: Leave blank to use the Gemini key
translations.Ex: Foque nos pontos sobre orçamento, li: E.g. Focus on the budget topics, list every deadline mentioned...
translations.Excluir {n} item(ns)? Essa ação não pode: Delete {n} item(s)? This action cannot be undone.
translations.Fala sendo convertida em texto em tempo: Speech converted to text in real time. When you stop, the transcript is refined with automatic speaker identification.
translations.Força o uso da Files API mesmo em arquiv: Forces the Files API even for small files. Useful for debugging.
translations.Gemini processa áudio nativamente (trans: Gemini handles audio natively (transcription + analysis in one model). OpenAI/Ollama transcribe with Whisper and use the provider's own chat model for summary/minutes/agenda/tasks — you don't need a Gemini key to use OpenAI or Ollama.
translations.Google Cloud Speech-to-Text (diarização: Google Cloud Speech-to-Text (native diarization, REST chunked)
translations.Identificamos vozes diferentes na gravaç: We detected distinct voices in the recording. Assign a name to each — we'll update the transcript with the real names.
translations.Identificando falantes pela voz. Isso le: Identifying speakers by voice. This takes a few seconds.
translations.Idioma principal dos áudios para melhor: Primary audio language for better transcription.
translations.Isso pode levar alguns minutos dependend: This may take a few minutes depending on the audio length
translations.Modelo de chat para gerar resumo/ata/pau: Chat model that generates the summary/minutes/agenda/tasks from the transcript. Used by OpenAI/Ollama (Whisper only transcribes). Empty = per-provider default (gpt-4o-mini for OpenAI, llama3.1 for Ollama). Ignored on Gemini.
translations.Modelo Live (bidiGenerateContent v1beta): Live model (bidiGenerateContent v1beta). Current: gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-12-2025 or gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview.
translations.Modelo usado para converter áudio em tex: Model used to convert audio to text.
translations.Não foi possível recuperar os chunks: Could not recover the audio chunks
translations.Nenhum nome preenchido — mantendo rótulo: No names filled — keeping original labels.
translations.O Google bloqueia uma chave restrita pra: Google blocks a Gemini-restricted key from calling Speech-to-Text. If you restricted your Gemini key, create a SEPARATE API key just for Speech-to-Text and paste it here. If both keys are unrestricted, leave empty.
translations.Opções específicas da versão beta. Os va: Beta-specific options. Defaults work well in most cases.
translations.Pasta vazia. Crie uma subpasta ou faça u: Empty folder. Create a subfolder or make a new recording.
translations.Permite capturar o áudio de uma aba ou t: Lets you capture the audio from a shared tab or screen.
translations.Quando ativo, mostra a transcrição em te: When enabled, shows live transcription while recording.
translations.Quantidade máxima de jobs (transcrição/r: Max number of jobs (transcribe/refine/split) per user in 24h. 0 = unlimited. Default: 50.
translations.Reconhecimento parado — clique em Parar: Recognition stopped — click Stop and start again.
translations.Renomear pasta/arquivo: use a aba Files: Rename folder/file: use the Nextcloud Files tab for now.
translations.Salva os arquivos de áudio na pasta: Saves audio files in the folder
translations.Selecione os grupos que podem usar o app: Pick the groups allowed to use the app. If none is selected, every user gets access.
translations.Selecione um ou mais formatos de saída: Pick one or more output formats
translations.Tamanho máximo permitido para arquivos d: Max allowed audio file size (in megabytes).
translations.Tipo de processamento padrão selecionado: Default processing type pre-selected when opening the app.
Base URL of the selected provider's API.
translations.Usar Google STT para transcrição (em vez: Use Google STT for transcription (instead of Gemini)
translations.Versão de testes restrita ao grupo admin: Test version restricted to the admin group. Settings independent from the production app.
translations.Web Speech abortou repetidamente. Outra: Web Speech aborted repeatedly. Another tab or app may be using the microphone.
translations.Web Speech API não suportada neste naveg: Web Speech API not supported in this browser. Use Chrome or Edge, or change the provider in admin.
translations.Web Speech usa o motor do Google em modo: Web Speech uses Google's engine in the browser's native streaming mode — high quality, no API cost, key never exposed. Gemini Live and Google STT require a key; they use the key configured above (and the dedicated Google STT key when set).
translations.Ambos os provedores funcionam para qualq: Both providers work for any allowed-group user without exposing the API key: Web Speech runs entirely in the browser; Google STT is proxied by the server (the key stays safely in Nextcloud).
translations.Você não tem permissão para usar o Audio: You do not have permission to use Audiolog.
translations.Fale com o administrador se precisar de: Contact your administrator if you need access.
translations.Ao iniciar, o navegador pedirá pra escol: When you start, the browser will ask you to pick a tab or window. Check "Share system audio".
translations.Configure o provedor de IA, controle qua: Configure the AI provider, choose which groups can use the app under "Access control" and enable live transcription as needed.
translations.Erro ao carregar painéis. Salvando em ar: Could not load the boards. Saving to a file...
translations.Excluir a pasta \"{n}\" e tudo dentro de: Delete the folder "{n}" and everything in it?
translations.Gemini 2.5+ suporta áudio nativo. Recome: Gemini 2.5+ supports audio natively. Recommended: gemini-2.5-flash (cheaper) or gemini-2.5-pro (quality).
translations.Google Cloud Speech-to-Text (proxy serve: Google Cloud Speech-to-Text (server-side proxy, any user)
translations.Gravação, transcrição e gestão de áudios: Record, transcribe and manage audio with AI
translations.Nenhum painel do Deck encontrado. Salvan: No Deck board found. Saving to a file...
translations.Não foi possível iniciar Web Speech. Ver: Could not start Web Speech. Check the microphone permission, close other tabs using the microphone and try again.
translations.Por favor, selecione um arquivo de audio: Please select a valid audio or video file
translations.Por favor, selecione um arquivo de áudio: Please select a valid audio or video file
translations.Por favor, solte um arquivo de audio ou: Please drop a valid audio or video file
translations.Quando ativo, transcrições do \"Processa: When enabled, "Process audio" transcriptions use Google Cloud Speech-to-Text with native speaker diarization. Summary/minutes/agenda/tasks stay on the LLM provider above. Cost: ~$0.024/min.
translations.Salva os arquivos de áudio na pasta \"Au: Saves the audio files in the user's "Audiolog" folder.
translations.Selecione o painel e a lista para export: Select the board and the list to export to
translations.Selecione pelo menos um tipo de saída: Select at least one output type
translations.Selecione um arquivo de áudio ou vídeo: Select an audio or video file
translations.Selecione um painel e uma lista: Select a board and a list
translations.Web Speech API (Chrome/Edge, grátis, bro: Web Speech API (Chrome/Edge, free, in the browser only)
translations.whisper-1 para transcrição, gpt-4o para: whisper-1 for transcription, gpt-4o for advanced analysis
translations.Áudio do sistema não detectado. Certifiq: System audio not detected. Make sure you check "Share system audio" when you pick the screen.
translations.Áudio do sistema não detectado. Marque \: System audio not detected. Check "Share system audio" when you pick the screen.
